### workspace rebase --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace rebase --onto local|update|remote|upstream [--name WORKSPACE] [--json]

Rebase a workspace's branch onto the repository's default branch.
  local    the local default branch; nothing is fetched
  update   fetch origin, move the local default branch up to origin's (stashing and
           restoring changes in the checkout that has it), then rebase onto it
  remote   fetch origin, rebase onto origin/<default>
  upstream fetch the branch's own upstream and rebase onto it; works on the default
           branch too (refused: no_upstream, upstream_gone)
A successful rebase rewrites the branch's commits. Refuses a workspace with changes to tracked
files and never stashes them. A rebase that stops on a conflict is aborted, so the workspace
is left as it was. Exits 0 for every outcome (rebased, up_to_date, conflict,
default_not_updated); read the outcome in the text or with --json. Exits 1 with an error when
it refuses or fails; --json prints the code (dirty_worktree, no_upstream, ...).

        --onto TARGET                local, update, remote or upstream (required)
        --name NAME                  The workspace (default: the one the current directory is in)
        --json                       Print one JSON document (see docs/README.rebase.md)
    -h, --help                       Show this help

Examples:
  workspace rebase --onto update    # catch the branch up with origin's default branch: fetches, may move the local default branch, rewrites this branch's commits
  workspace rebase --onto local    # rebase onto the local default branch with nothing fetched, for example offline
  workspace rebase --onto remote --name api.worktree-PROJ-123 --json    # another workspace, for a script: rebase onto origin/<default> and read the outcome, even a conflict exits 0
  workspace rebase --onto upstream    # pick up commits others pushed to this branch itself; also works on the default branch
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace rebase

--- stdout

Missing --onto local|update|remote|upstream.
